newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Apr cargo performance improves.
newsitem.headline: Air France Apr cargo performance improves.

text.p: Air France said it transported 420.5 million freight tonne kilometres (FTKs) last month, an increase of 9.2 percent on April 1996.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
The overall cargo load factor in April 1997 was up 4.7 percentage points on the same month in 1996 to 69.8 percent, the airline said.
In its last financial year -- which ran from April 1, 1996-March 31, 1997 -- Air France transported 4.86 billion FTKs, up 5.7 percent on April 1995-March 1996.
Overall cargo load factor during April 1996-March 1997 was up was up 0.8 percentage points on the same period the previous year to 69.4 percent, the airline added.
